propositions: Every verification index in Pass-2 is rejected as unexpected when Plan-1 yields zero findings, causing all findings to degrade to INDETERMINATE despite an unchanged PASS verdict

Empty finding batches trigger verify_instructions() to return an imperative to emit verifications with no findings listed, causing the verifier to return indices 0..N-1 which are all marked unexpected against valid_indices=range(0)
INDETERMINATE findings cannot cause a block decision because pass3_decide() short-circuits blocking logic and partition_findings routes degraded findings to advisory rather than blocking paths
The fix changes verify_instructions() to return EMPTY_BATCH_INSTRUCTIONS for empty batches, mirroring the contract prerequisite_workflow_ops already states
Deterministic unit test test_verify_empty_batch_contract.py fails before the fix and passes after, covering the zero-finding repaired branch
